summary: Train to map tourism chatbot journeys, review guest-facing answers, and plan human escalation. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: AI and chatbot training for tourism professionals helps teams design and assess bounded guest-facing chatbot workflows. It is for guest-service supervisors, tourism operations managers, and digital product specialists handling booking, itinerary, and service requests. Participants practise mapping guest intents and journeys, checking knowledge-base information and response accuracy, designing human handoffs, and monitoring task completion to guide rollout decisions.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who shape, operate, assess, or support guest-facing AI and chatbot services in tourism. It is designed for people who need to connect guest requests with dependable service information and workable human escalation.
prerequisites: Working experience in tourism services, guest communications, or digital customer support is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
